newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea H1 o'seas investment approvals down-papers.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea H1 o'seas investment approvals down-papers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea on Wednesday said South Korea's direct overseas investment dropped to $2.73 billion in the first half of this year on an approval basis from $2.98 billion a year ago, according to local newspapers.
Newspapers said the number of investments dropped to 727 in the first half from 928 a year earlier.
The central bank attributed the decline to the nation's economic slump and difficulties in raising funds abroad.
